title: test(app-shell): wait on the whole list in the report index suite's positive cases
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8SfRz7pGa2P99NAztqiusfy)_
Fixes #27116

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改一个测试文件:报表索引测试套件里所有「期望看到完整列表」的用例,改为等到整个列表出现再断言,而不是等到某一项出现就立即断言。
- **为什么改**:⌘K 面板里通过导航项出现的报表会先出现,导航外的报表要等报表列表返回后才出现;原用例等到 Gamma 就断言全部四项,CI 负载高时 Delta 还没到,导致合并队列里的 PR 被误踢出。
- **风险与回滚**:极低:只改测试,不改产品代码,不跳过、不重试、不调超时;回滚即还原本 PR 的一个提交。
- **先看**:`AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx` 中「(f) CONTROL: offers it, once, to a member granted that permission」一例,以及 `indexSettled` 上方的说明。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx --sequence.shuffle`,预期 18 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Test-only, one file: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx`.

- **The race.** "(f) CONTROL: offers it, once, to a member granted that permission" waited for Gamma, then asserted the full palette list synchronously. The palette offers a nav-named report (Gamma) through its navigation entry at once, and Delta (named by no entry) only once the report list answers, so on a loaded shard the assertion ran with Delta still missing (received Alpha, Beta, Gamma). It now waits on the full list: `waitFor(() => expect(paletteReports()).toEqual(ALL))`.
- **Siblings audited.** Every case that expects a list now waits on that list itself: the index's four positive controls (they waited for the Gamma link, then read the list; safe today because the index renders its list from one answer, changed so no case leans on that), and the palette's "(e) CONTROL" (it waited for Delta through `paletteSettled`, then read the list). The negative cases keep their settle-then-assert shape: a negative is asserted after the lists have answered (`indexSettled` / `paletteSettled` wait for Delta, which no gate hides), and the permissions provider renders nothing before its answer, so no later answer can add the hidden entry. A doc comment above `indexSettled` says the settles serve the negatives only, and why.
- ⛔ No source change, no skip, no retry, no timeout change.

## Tests

The race was reproduced by a one-off mutation of the suite's adapter double, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores the file and proves it matches HEAD each time:

- **Red, before the fix** (head `6817bf1e`): the report list answer delayed 300 ms. Result: "(f) CONTROL: offers it, once, to a member granted that permission" fails with Delta missing; the other 17 cases pass.
- **Green, after the fix** (head `b24c61d8`): the same 300 ms delay gives 18/18; report and dataset lists both delayed 600 ms gives 18/18; plain run 18/18; `--sequence.shuffle` 18/18.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` moved after the branch point (`6817bf1e` to `e6e41998`, 84 files), and none of them is this suite or the source it covers; the branch is not merged with main for a test-only change, and CI runs the PR's merge ref.
